note: Temporary illustrations drawn in the app for development. They are original to this project, not third-party stock, and they are not approved as final production art.
vocabulary: Custom-painted pictures for the reviewed word list in vocabulary_generator.dart.
findDifference: Six original scene pairs drawn at display size by DifferenceSceneView. Differences are the extra objects listed in difference_catalog.dart. There are no 1600x1200 master PNG pairs and no runtime WebP files. Hit regions stay normalized from 0 to 1 so they follow the painted picture when the board resizes.
avatars: Eight stable ids: sprout, sun, fox, owl, fish, star, turtle, butterfly. Drawn in avatar_badge.dart. Not final production art.
themeArt: assets/art/: fox_wave.png and seven category pictures, generated 2 October 2026 with the Cursor image tool for this project from written prompts, using the approved fox artwork and the owner's Home/Explore concepts as references. No text inside the pictures. Owner confirmation needed before store release. See docs/asset_licenses.md.
regionalArt: assets/art/category_hindi.jpg and category_discover_india.jpg, generated 3 October 2026 the same way, using the owner's Explore concept as the style reference. No text, letters, flags, maps or monuments inside the pictures. Owner confirmation needed before store release. See docs/asset_licenses.md.
appIcon: Owner-approved fox/book/sprout artwork, supplied 2 October 2026 as a flattened 1024x1024 JPEG. Used only by uniform resizing for the Play icon, launcher icons, splash and assets/brand/sproutlab_fox.png. The themed-icon monochrome layer is a stencil traced from the same artwork.
